TypeParameters.Name: Description
TypeParameters.Value: Crane gate valves offer the ultimate in dependable service wherever minimum pressure drop is important

TypeParameters.Name: UK End Connection
TypeParameters.Value: Taper threaded to BS EN 10226-2 (ISO 7-1) formerly BS 21

TypeParameters.Name: Specification Notes
TypeParameters.Value: Valves 1/4"" to 2"" are manufactured in accordance with BS EN 12288 2010 PN16 for Series B ratings. Non-Rising Stem. This valve is not suitable for use on group 1 gases or unstable fluids as defined by the Pressure Equipment Directive 97/23/EC

TypeParameters.Name: Operator
TypeParameters.Value: Handwheel. Gate valves are best for services that require infrequent valve operation and where the disc is kept either fully opened or fully closed. They are not practical for throttling
